criteria.requirement: Repair CheckedPMap.create recursive key/value construction and optional pmap_field factory to forward the already-declared ignore_extra policy. Existing correctly typed instances remain reused, default False still rejects unknown record fields, and non-extra type/invariant failures propagate. Preserve _factory_fields signature compatibility for optional factories without forcing ignore_extra onto ordinary user factories outside the checked-type protocol. Validate multiple map/record/class levels and optional None, not only a single shallow example.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
